description: Narrow this session's memory to one project: name='<slug>' scopes recall, the wake bundle, self-notes and the default namespace for new facts to project:<slug>:* (identity and conventions always ride along). Returns the narrowed bundle right away. name='' widens back to the whole account. Sticky for the session and across reconnects; bind_agent is unaffected. The same call ENTERS a workspace someone shared with this account: name='<their name>' (or their tenant id, or the granted prefix, as listed by list_workspaces) switches this connection into it; no second server, no header, no restart; it holds for the session, and a new session re-enters with the same call. name='' leaves it. When a person asks to work in someone else's shared memory, call this.

name.description: Project slug (the <slug> in project:<slug>:*), the name of a granted workspace to enter (from list_workspaces), or '' to widen / leave.

name: switch_workspace
title: Switch Workspace
